input.quote: 9.1 Accounting. Each Party will maintain materially complete and accurate accounting records related to this Agreement in accordance with GAAP. Each Party will retain such records for [***] after the earlier of expiration or early termination of this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement gives SFJ no audit, inspection or verification right over PB, its records, facilities or systems. Article 9 (Records) imposes only mutual record-keeping and retention duties (p0624, p0625) with no accompanying right of access or examination, and no underpayment/true-up verification mechanic exists anywhere (searches for audit, inspection, examine, access, books and records, underpayment return nothing responsive). Section 3.6 is not an audit of PB: 3.6.1 is a mutual obligation on each Party to audit its own Permitted Third Parties and share reports, and 3.6.2 obliges PB to audit the manufacturing facilities under its own internal policies and give SFJ the reports — both run in PB's favour or are PB-controlled, not an SFJ right to audit PB. Section 3.18.2 is a financial reporting/executive-meeting disclosure covenant, not an audit or system-access right. Because no audit right binds PB, the position is better than the preferred checklist (no frequency, notice, cost or system-access exposure to limit) and well clear of walk-away territory; there is nothing to redline. Noted only for the record: if SFJ later seeks a verification right, we would insist on the preferred parameters (once per 12 months, 30 days' notice, business hours, independent auditor under confidentiality, off-site where possible, SFJ cost unless underpayment exceeds 5%, no direct system access).
